decisions.reason: Requiring a randomly distributed commission to appear in NFT attributes changes metadata content, not the existing media-rendering and cover-presentation behavior.
Commission visibility does not change which book access, referral identity, badges, or prize tickets follow an NFT after transfer.
The metadata-display decision does not change the required blockchain network.
Random no-referral commission visibility does not alter secondary-sale royalties, ERC-721C controls, or marketplace policy.
Displaying a commission in attributes does not change whether an owner can locate an NFT in the wallet or dashboard.
The decision adds commission information to NFT attributes but does not change the NFT's referral-code source, persistence, or display locations.
The source conditionally mentions revising UI notes but does not necessarily or specifically revise the product FAQ copy.
The commission's amount, trigger, recipient selection, and allocation coverage remain unchanged; visibility in NFT attributes is independently represented by the metadata requirement.
The source leaves ticket generation unresolved, and that same-message uncertainty is already represented by the candidate's AMBIGUOUS Event; the source MODIFY concerns commission visibility instead.
The required commission display concerns the dashboard and NFT attributes, not landing-page content or layout.
The source concerns a randomly distributed commission for a no-code purchase, not the commission paid to a chosen referrer when a referral is accepted.
Commission visibility in NFT attributes does not affect the landing-page book cover's placement, size, or cropping.
